detail: Backfill's job is repairing the missing pointer, not relitigating lifecycle; silently retiring an active decision during housekeeping is the higher-risk action. Targets that are active despite an incoming supersedes link (re-promoted, or store-level writes) keep their status and gain the pointer.
summary: Housekeeping backfill preserves the target's current status — it writes only the missing superseded_by pointer, never flips active/archived/overridden to superseded
